start.text: Chai? Fifteen. Strong. You are Aunty's new tenant? Whole hill knows already.

chai.text: Sit on the stool, nobody is coming for an hour. Signal is better near my stall than in half the houses, you know. I should charge.

bye.text: I'm here from six to ten, both sides of the day.

act4.text: (Mani, behind his chained-up stall, on a crate.) Stall's shut. Listen — the lower path, by the shrine: two of them, facing the wall. Don't walk past. Crawl. The stairs on the right are quiet. Suresh has the light up top.
